summary: Target: the inference 'uniqueness among admitted states implies an r-root', not CCR 20babef7 itself; the failure of CCR on this two-bearer profile comes from the existing #1871 control (SourceFreeFiniteCircleControl), which this attempt reuses. An unregistered, kernel-checked state-indexed control makes InAct vary with candidate Boolean states on the fixed q3a4 ActualEsseCause relation. It is one structural instance of #1878's borrowing framework: circleRule is an EntirelyBorrowedRule for sourceFreeFiniteCircle and CircleStateFixed is SupplierStateFixed circleRule with the biconditional flipped, so the empty fixed point is an instance of emptyFixedOfEntirelyBorrowed (varying InAct preserves it). Both the empty and the two-bearer populated configurations satisfy the guarded equation; an added nonempty-admission condition makes the populated state the only admitted one pointwise, yet no member is an r-root. Scope: mode-unspecified r only. The witness is a two-element cycle, which noPerSeCausalLoop excludes at the per se productive scope once the priority bridge is supplied. The acyclic analogue StateIndexedTailControl (Nat, n+1 causes n) shows that nonemptiness does not select there: every tail is fixed, nonempty and rootless, so a per se holist needs a stronger admission (maximality or a named member), whose price is OPEN. No ontic law, concrete whole, exercised productive power, full existential ground or necessity is encoded; a state is not a world and CausesIn is not varied, so #1878's open bridge remains open. No corpus argument/result registration and no premise discharge. Existing #1878 all-state selection and #1882 collective A/B routes reused, not duplicated.
blocker: OPEN: an actual existentially productive or constitutively full-grounded holistic interpretation with real members, powers and organization; an independent reason the global admission holds (modal necessity, governing structure or primitive obtaining), which at the per se productive scope must be stronger than nonemptiness; scope from actual exercises to r and collective supplier-cone completeness; compare whole vs unreceived source under symmetric explanation standard. #1878's states-as-total-existence-alternatives bridge remains open. #1616 full inertia countermodel and causal-mode bridge remain separate.
